title: Forward and inverse components of full-faithful cancellation
statement:
Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B,\mathcal D$ be categories [def-nagata-category], let $F,G:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be functors, and let $J:\mathcal B\to\mathcal D$ be fully faithful, meaning that every map $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal B}(B,B')\to\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal D}(JB,JB')$ is bijective. Given a natural isomorphism $\beta:JF\xrightarrow{\sim}JG$, write $\operatorname{preim}_J$ for the inverse of this Hom bijection. Full-faithful cancellation gives a natural isomorphism $\alpha:F\xrightarrow{\sim}G$ with, for every $K\in\mathcal A$,
$$\alpha^{\mathrm{hom}}_K=\operatorname{preim}_J(\beta^{\mathrm{hom}}_K),\qquad \alpha^{\mathrm{inv}}_K=\operatorname{preim}_J(\beta^{\mathrm{inv}}_K).$$
Consequently its two components satisfy
$$J(\alpha^{\mathrm{hom}}_K)=\beta^{\mathrm{hom}}_K,\qquad J(\alpha^{\mathrm{inv}}_K)=\beta^{\mathrm{inv}}_K.$$
The chosen cancellation is $\texttt{CategoryTheory.Functor.fullyFaithfulCancelRight}$, including both its specified component maps.
